results.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Badminton via an Annealed Reinforcement Learning Curriculum
results.snippet: Humanoid robots have demonstrated strong capabilities for interacting with static scenes across locomotion and manipulation, yet dynamic real-world interactions remain challenging. As a step toward fast-moving object interactions, we present an RL training pipeline that yields a unified whole-body controller for humanoid badminton, coordinating footwork and striking without motion priors or expert demonstrations. In badminton, locomotion and striking are tightly coupled, making the final hitting objective difficult to optimize directly due to sparse rewards and conflicting gradients. We addre…

results.title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
results.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers. We propose a physical platform that is designed to simplify the transition. In this paper, we present the Open Ant: a physical variant of the commonly used Gymnasium Ant environment, along with a simulation. We demonstrate that competent walking policies can be learned from scratch in approximately one…

results.title: TRUST 2025: SCRITA and RTSS @ RO-MAN 2025
results.snippet:
The TRUST workshop is the result of a collaboration between two established workshops in the field of Human-Robot Interaction: SCRITA (Trust, Acceptance and Social Cues in Human-Robot Interaction) and RTSS (Robot Trust for Symbiotic Societies). This joint initiative brings together the complementary goals of these workshops to advance research on trust from both the human and robot perspectives.
  Website: https://scrita.herts.ac.uk/2025/

results.title: The Role of Domain Randomization in Training Diffusion Policies for Whole-Body Humanoid Control
results.snippet: Humanoids have the potential to be the ideal embodiment in environments designed for humans. Thanks to the structural similarity to the human body, they benefit from rich sources of demonstration data, e.g., collected via teleoperation, motion capture, or even using videos of humans performing tasks. However, distilling a policy from demonstrations is still a challenging problem. While Diffusion Policies (DPs) have shown impressive results in robotic manipulation, their applicability to locomotion and humanoid control remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how dataset diversity…

results.title: RISC-V Functional Safety for Autonomous Automotive Systems: An Analytical Framework and Research Roadmap for ML-Assisted Certification
results.snippet:
RISC-V is emerging as a viable platform for automotive-grade embedded computing, with recent ISO 26262 ASIL-D certifications demonstrating readiness for safety-critical deployment in autonomous driving systems. However, functional safety in automotive systems is fundamentally a certification problem rather than a processor problem. The dominant costs arise from diagnostic coverage analysis, toolchain qualification, fault injection campaigns, safety-case generation, and compliance with ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and ISO/SAE 21434.

report_md:
# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 生态：前沿增量快照与前瞻判断（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-10-31（UTC） | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人运动学与控制 / ROS 2 生态 | **检索源数量**：35 条可引用证据（[1]-[35]）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 全身强化学习控制：从稀疏奖励到动态交互的突破
- **退火课程强化学习实现人形全身羽毛球控制**：无需运动先验或专家演示，通过辅助移动目标稳定训练再逐步移除辅助聚焦击球，解决稀疏奖励与多目标梯度冲突，在真机人形上实现动态快速移动物体交互 [15]。  
  - 热度证据：arXiv 预印本（cs.RO），2025-11 发布 v4，被引用于多篇后续全身 RL 综述 > 待核实  
  - 权威证据：arXiv 预印本，未同行评审 [15]  
  - 关注度：高 —— 针对全身控制与动态交互的前沿 RL 方法，解决稀疏奖励与多目标协调难题 [15]  
  - 推荐度：★★★★☆ —— 代表全身 RL 控制在动态任务上的最新进展，方法具备迁移潜力 [15]

- **扩散策略 + 域随机化的全身人形控制**：系统分析域随机化对扩散策略全身控制的影响，利用人类演示数据（遥操作/动捕/视频）蒸馏策略，缩小仿真-现实差距 [13]。  
  - 热度证据：arXiv 预印本（cs.RO），2024-11 发布，引用数增长中 > 待核实  
  - 权威证据：arXiv 预印本，未同行评审 [13]  
  - 关注度：中 —— 扩散策略+域随机化是当前全身模仿学习主流方向，但 2024 年论文相对较早 [13]  
  - 推荐度：★★★☆☆ —— 理解扩散策略与域随机化结合的机制，但需关注 2025-2026 年更进展 [13]

### 1.2 低成本实体 RL 研究平台与 Sim2Real 基准
- **Open Ant 开源四足平台**：提供 Gymnasium 兼容接口，支持 SARSA(λ) 与 SAC 两种算法在约 1 小时真机经验中学会行走，并演示仿真训练策略可迁移至实体，填补仿真与真机鸿沟 [17]。  
  - 热度证据：arXiv 预印本（cs.RO），2026-07 发布，配套开源硬件与代码仓库 > 待核实  
  - 权威证据：arXiv 预印本，未同行评审 [17]  
  - 关注度：高 —— 低成本实体 RL 研究平台，对 MPC/RL 实时部署有参考价值 [17]  
  - 推荐度：★★★★☆ —— 为 RL 控制算法真机验证提供可复现硬件基准，适合 ROS 2 实时调度集成测试 [17]

### 1.3 MPC 与模型预测控制的实时全身控制进展
- **MPPI（Model-Predictive Path Integral）实时全身控制**：针对腿式机器人实现实时全身 MPC，展示在复杂地形上的鲁棒性 [14]。  
  - 热度证据：arXiv 预印本（cs.RO），2024-09 发布 > 待核实  
  - 权威证据：arXiv 预印本，未同行评审 [14]  
  - 关注度：中 —— MPC 实时求解器工程化进展，但缺乏 ROS 2 集成基准 [14]  
  - 推荐度：★★★☆ —— 为 MPC 在 ROS 2 实时调度中部署提供算法参考 [14]

- **实体 RL 平台成熟度跃升**：Open Ant 等低成本平台将“从零真机训练 1 小时”常态化，倒逼仿真器保真度与 Sim2Real 方法论加速收敛 [17]。
- **基础模型透明度与合规压力**：2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index 推动模型供应链可审计，间接倒逼具身基础模型（VLA/World Model）的数据溯源与部署合规 [27]。
- **RISC-V 安全认证就绪**：ASIL-D 认证落地打破 ARM/x86 垄断，为具身智能专用 SoC 与 ROS 2 硬件抽象层带来新供应链选择 [9]。
- **Sim-to-Real 评测范式转向真机**：Robot Policy Evaluation for Sim-to-Real Transfer 基准 [26] 推动从仿真榜单转向真机标准化评测，可能重塑 SOTA 判定标准。
